gaps.lead: The journey was so tiring that we slept all day.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that we slept all day.
gaps.explanation: so tiring (a journey) → such a tiring journey.

gaps.lead: I think learning to use a typewriter is a waste of time.
gaps.sentence: I can't ___ how to use a typewriter.
gaps.explanation: 'A waste of time' becomes 'can't see the point in/of doing it'.

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was so rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ so rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing: apologised for being so rude.

gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring my camera.
gaps.explanation: 'If only I had brought' expresses regret about the past.

gaps.lead: The Minister sat down, and immediately the journalists began shouting.
gaps.sentence: ___ sat down than the journalists began shouting.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had + subject + participle … than' with inversion replaces 'and immediately'.
